currentTransformation.title: Transform the real autonomous climb into a legible, cinematic, responsive expedition
currentTransformation.state: REAL OUTCOME / RESTART SLICE COMMITTED — WHOLE-GAME QUALITY NOT EVALUATED
currentTransformation.promise: One coherent climb: monumental original 3D environments, grounded grip-to-landing motion, tactical visible decisions, understandable guardian danger and opt-in terrain-aware spatial sound, with a minimal in-game HUD.
currentTransformation.nextDecision: The actual live result now holds 48 fixed 20Hz steps (2.4 seconds), followed by an authentic intermission/restart; an original source-bound 3D loss memorial and optional audio make this observable. Inspect complete normal-speed desktop and portrait source-matched videos at the committed candidate source, verify physical movement/guardian/terminal transitions and correct slow software-GL render tails. The frozen baseline result lasts one tick and must not be rewritten. Five fresh blind independent LOOKS/FEELS/PLAYS critics, device p50/p95/p99 + memory, replay/accessibility/stability remain mandatory. Source implementation is NOT visual proof.
currentTransformation.rejectedMicroMilestones: A green CI run, an isolated pose fix, a prettier screenshot or an extra UI icon never counts as a Gauntlet win.
currentTransformation.biggestRemainingExperienceGap: Unverified in-motion physical weight and guardian engagement at real display frame rates, with no independently accepted complete run outcome/restart for both viewports.
